independent_review.scope: Stage 2 empirical audit of unchanged r1 and r2; assessment is conditional on data coverage and finite prefixes.
independent_review.summary: An independent Codex reviewer reconstructed 639,334 dated member-price observations, checked all ten replay ledgers, and recalculated 23,951 fill fees and 10,391 closed outcomes across the funded, equal-risk and excluded-shadow cohorts. The audit reproduced all twelve qualification verdicts, confirmed eight holdings conversions, and found a maximum funded-account discrepancy below ₹0.000001. Independent next-open checks reproduced 88,777 missed or invalidated calls. Three funded account-windows stop at their last supportable valuation. The early archive’s sparse price bands and the heavy concentration of measured closes in 2024–2026 limit historical inference.
independent_review.tests: Independent full suite: 153 passed at review; independent audit scripts do not import ThesisTally strategy or metrics modules for trading results.

interpretation: **Trend pullback — not enough data for an edge verdict.** At equal risk, r2 closed 2,953 trades. On the 2,847 mature trades from sufficiently sampled windows, mean net expectancy was −0.075R with a 90% interval of −0.153R to +0.007R. Two of ten planned windows contributed a positive vote. The upper bound is well below the required +0.25R. Across all closes the signal lost 0.027R before costs, and costs took another 0.075R. Of 1,780 losers, 323 reached +1R while held. The median losing price stop triggered on session six and exited on session seven.

**Volatility breakout — not enough data for an edge verdict.** R2 brought 350 equal-risk trades to a measured close. Its 314 counted mature trades averaged −0.133R, with a 90% interval of −0.265R to +0.010R. One of ten windows contributed a positive vote. Across all closes, mean gross R was −0.081 and costs averaged 0.065R. Only 31 of 222 losers reached +1R. The 12 observed funded closes averaged +0.712R after costs; that funded sample is too small to qualify the strategy.

**52-week-high momentum — not enough data.** There were 41 detections across training and testing. All passed liquidity and 35 failed the signal stop bounds. Every one of those 35 failed the 2.5 ATR ceiling, and one also exceeded the percentage limit. Five of the 37 test-period plans passed the signal stop. Two reached a funded allocation and neither could be bought at the next open. No revision or book closed a momentum trade. The conflict between the base-low stop and the ATR ceiling is documented for Stage 3 consideration.

**When the losses occurred.** Both r2 equal-risk strategies lost money on average in each of 2024, 2025 and 2026 through 20 November. These three signal years contributed 2,789 of 2,953 closed pullbacks and 335 of 350 closed breakouts. In 2023 they were positive on 54 and eight closes respectively. All eligible entries came from gate-on signals. Pullbacks exiting on a gate-off day averaged −0.558R across 901 closes versus +0.099R across 2,052 gate-on closes. Breakouts averaged −0.569R across 116 gate-off closes and +0.063R across 234 gate-on closes. The exit-day gate uses that session’s close. This association cannot establish what an earlier exit would have earned.

**What r1 adds.** R1 had 610 observed equal-risk pullback closes averaging −0.168R net and 70 breakout closes averaging −0.099R net. Its momentum count was also zero. R2 admitted substantially more trades. Both versions failed qualification under the predeclared criteria. The final out-of-sample evidence will come from future paper sessions after a freeze.
### Three funded windows with an unpriced position

All ten test windows ran in both revisions and both books. Thirty-seven of the 40 book-windows reached their scheduled end. Each equal-risk book reached all ten ends, with any unmeasurable call retained explicitly. A funded account requires a defensible daily valuation of every position. When that failed the entire session rolled back, and only the previously committed prefix is reported. The following annual window began independently with ₹10 lakh. The three shortened funded book-windows cannot contribute trades or votes to qualification.

In 2021 the r2 funded portfolio bought 566 INDHOTEL shares on 24 June. INDHOTEL entered derivatives trading on 25 June. Its time exit triggered on 22 July, but all 75 subsequent openings through 10 November had a dynamic band with no verified lower limit. On 11 November a 1-for-9 rights issue entitled the position to 62 independently tradable rights. A holder could sell, subscribe or let them lapse; the frozen rules specify no election. R2 therefore committed 212 of 248 sessions. The rights first traded on 24 November. Their later trading price could not supply a pre-open valuation or restore an earlier sale. [NSE derivatives circular](https://archives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FAOP48731.pdf) · [Issuer’s offer, page 274](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/nov-2021/1637557043074.pdf) · [NSE rights listing](https://archives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CML50361.pdf)

In 2024 both funded accounts held ADANIPORTS when it closed at ₹1,248.95 on 4 June, down 21.15% from ₹1,583.95. The dated NSE finals confirm the move. No corporate action explained it, so the mandatory closing quarantine prevented the account mark. Both accounts committed 105 of 249 sessions, ending on 3 June. Their 2024 returns in the benchmark table cover that observed period. [3 June NSE equity final](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/historical/EQUITIES/2024/JUN/cm03JUN2024bhav.csv.zip) · [4 June NSE equity final](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/historical/EQUITIES/2024/JUN/cm04JUN2024bhav.csv.zip)

**What remains unknown.** Opening ranges were verified for 147,270 of 639,334 traded member observations. The missing ranges can prevent a purchase or keep a pending sale open. In the r2 funded book, missing lower limits delayed 56 pullback positions and four breakout positions. Some delays spanned months. Sparse early results and the shortened accounts limit any comparison of allocation effects. No historical parameter experiment was run.

methodology.bootstrap: Percentile 90% two-sided interval on the trade-weighted mean. Resample distinct signal sessions with replacement, keeping all same-date trades together. Fewer than two distinct dates have no interval. This controls same-date dependence; overlapping positions opened on different dates may still be correlated.
methodology.corporate_actions: With/without splits include cash dividends, compulsory corporate-action journal events and unresolved corporate actions. The separate compulsory and dividend subsets may overlap.
methodology.costs: For each trade, R is original whole shares times slipped buy less original stop. Gross keeps the actual entries, exits, quantity, dividends and compulsory cash fixed, reverses each fill's adverse slippage and adds back actual charged fees. Mean gross R minus mean fee R and slippage R equals mean net R. Holder-specific income taxes are excluded.
methodology.days_to_stop: Only net losing trades exited by a price stop. Count exchange sessions from purchase through stop trigger, inclusive (entry day = 1); also show time through actual sale. A time exit has its own exit-reason group.
methodology.diagnostic_cohort: All journalled calls in the scheduled test windows. Outcomes, distributions, costs, exit statistics and win rates use measured closed trades. Open, pending, unmeasurable and immature counts are shown separately. Results by year/sector/regime use information on the signal date.
methodology.equal_risk: Independent positions can overlap without a pooled balance. A descriptive curve sums measured calls' actual cash flows, remaining marked shares and outstanding receivables. It retains live positions and excludes every entered unmeasurable call throughout. P&L, peak-to-trough rupee loss and gross exposure are normalized to the fixed INR 1,000,000 reference. They are not investable account returns, drawdown or margin requirements.
methodology.exit_and_risk: Final economic exit reason and date are recorded at the stock disposition if fractional cash arrives later. MAE is signed in original risk units; MFE is positive favourable movement. On an intraday single-share exit the adverse low may follow the sale; lower/upper possible MAE quantiles are shown. A +1R event occurs while exposed by final sale. An opening exit uses only the opening price. Same-session +1R vs a stop-first collision has uncertain intraday ordering.
methodology.funded_account: Window starts at the configured capital. Drawdown uses the peak of daily marked equity including starting cash. Exposure is mean daily marked stock value divided by daily equity. Per-strategy curves attribute that strategy's positions and cash flows to the same starting capital. Nifty 200 buy-and-hold uses the first and last observed session closes.
methodology.qualification: Only closed trades whose signal had at least the configured full holding horizon of subsequent observed exchange sessions by that window's end. An incomplete replay cannot qualify. A calendar-short last window is evaluated over its scheduled sessions. Only complete windows with at least 20 mature closes contribute trades or positive votes; all planned test windows remain in the breadth denominator.
methodology.regime: Entry cohorts are conditioned on the signal-date gate. Exit-date net P&L includes the full life of trades ending under each gate. Marked daily P&L from both new and existing positions is also split by that day's closing gate; this descriptive attribution does not use the gate to trade retroactively.
methodology.verdict: Edge requires every qualification criterion. No edge requires at least 100 mature trades in counted windows, all windows replayed and a 90% upper bound at or below zero. Other cases receive not enough data, including evidence that is positive but inconclusive. Verdicts are conditional on available market and surveillance data.
